reuse.why: Extends the existing shared getScheduledAmount and reuses the tree's getApproxNumberThreshold from shared/rules for the 7.5% tolerance instead of recomputing it.

duplication.why: The approximate worst case is written once in a small helper beside the range one; call sites only pass their operator.

placement.why: The rule lives in shared/schedules.ts next to the existing worst-case range logic that every planning consumer already calls.

scope.why: Only the helper, its planning call sites and tests change; the search-filter display sites are left alone.

maintainability.why: Centralised and readable, but the operator is an optional untyped string after a positional boolean, so callers must pass a bare false and can silently forget the op.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All planning call sites go through getScheduledAmount; the tolerance comes from getApproxNumberThreshold.

disguised_duplication.where: No duplicated logic; the tolerance helper is reused.

one_place.where: getScheduledAmount in shared/schedules.ts decides the approximate worst case (via getWorstCaseApproxAmount); callers only supply the operator.
